passage: Coaches often say that talent matters less than reliability. Maya is known among her teammates for being ______: she arrives at every practice early and has not missed a single game in three seasons.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
steps: Clue: she arrives early and has never missed a game in three seasons.
That shows she can be counted on: dependable.
"Forgetful" and "unpredictable" contradict the clue; "outspoken" (speaking freely) is unrelated.
key: Restate the clue in your own words before looking at the choices.
